documented_gaps.PREPROD_HUMAN_PRINCIPAL_FAMILY_SINGLE: The story needs three distinct Human principals (manager/owner/outsider) plus per-Human Bot registration; the preprod pilot credential family is one Human Cookie plus its dedicated registered Bots (profile actors driver/member only), so the three-Human ownership isolation matrix cannot be expressed.
documented_gaps.PREPROD_PARTICIPANT_ROUTES_UNBOUND: participants PATCH/POST/DELETE, session collect add/remove, view_bot_id-scoped session listing, message history and Bot visibility are outside the reviewed public-v1 route bindings (route_bindings.py binds group/session CRUD, messages, token and the register trio only).
documented_gaps.PREPROD_PRINCIPAL_MINTING_OPERATOR_KEY: public-v1 X-Avernet-Principal tokens are minted from AVERNET_SECRET_PRINCIPAL_SIGNING_KEY_VALUE; the owned-local Singlebox runtime mints from its per-run key while a gateway profile needs an operator-provisioned auth.principal_signing_key_env reference the preprod pilot profile does not declare.
documented_gaps.PREPROD_STATION_BOOTSTRAP_FACE_ABSENT: ensure-human, register-token, register, onboard, visibility PUT and station Bot delete are legacy station products with per-request X-Mock-User-Id admission on the owned-local runtime only; the preprod public-v1 gateway face exposes none of them and mock-header admission does not exist there.
